text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now then... regarding these 'potato chips'
that were sent to us as refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Worry not.
This time, we shall use neither cutlery nor gloves.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Using cutlery shatters them to pieces...
Gloves cause the oil and salt to seep through...
I, too, am deepening my learning each day in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now then—
let us partake with bare hands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Could you prepare a finger bowl with a slice of lemon and water?
Along with a napkin, if you please.
